#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

static const int MOD = 1000000007;

static int add(int a, int b) {
    int res = a + b;
    if (res >= MOD) {
        res -= MOD;
    }
    return res;
}

static int solve(int n) {
    int N = 2 * n;
    std::vector<std::vector<int>> dp0(N + 1, std::vector<int>(N + 1, 0));
    std::vector<std::vector<int>> dp1(N + 1, std::vector<int>(N + 1, 0));

    for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            int val = 0;
            if (i - j >= 2) {
                val = add(val, dp0[i - 1][j + 1]);
            }
            if (j > 0) {
                val = add(val, dp0[i - 1][j - 1]);
            }
            dp1[i][j] = val;

            int best = 0;
            int cur = 0;
            if (i - j >= 2) {
                cur = add(cur, dp0[i - 1][j + 1]);
            }
            if (j > 0) {
                cur = add(cur, dp0[i - 1][j - 1]);
            }
            best = std::max(best, cur);

            cur = 0;
            if (i - j >= 2) {
                cur = add(cur, dp0[i - 1][j + 1]);
            }
            if (j > 0) {
                cur = add(cur, dp1[i - 1][j - 1]);
                cur = add(cur, 1);
            }
            best = std::max(best, cur);

            cur = 0;
            if (i - j >= 2) {
                cur = add(cur, dp1[i - 1][j + 1]);
                cur = add(cur, 1);
            }
            if (j > 0) {
                cur = add(cur, dp0[i - 1][j - 1]);
            }
            best = std::max(best, cur);

            dp0[i][j] = best;
        }
    }
    return dp0[N][0];
}

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::cout << solve(n) << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
